item.title: [Infraestrutura] CVE-2026-119119 - Docker
item.description:
🚨 CVE-2026-119119 - Docker
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Docker
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 7.5
Resumo:
Crawl4AI before 0.9.5 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the Docker API server where _clamp_untrusted() fails to cap the delay_before_return_html, mean_delay, and max_range fields of untrusted CrawlerRunConfig bodies. Unauthenticated attackers can send huge values to /crawl or /crawl/stream to hold browser pages or stall the rate limiter, exhausting the page pool and blocking other crawls.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-119119

item.title: [Sistemas / Cloud] CVE-2026-119566 - Azure
item.description:
🚨 CVE-2026-119566 - Azure
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Azure
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 4.8
Resumo:
Prometheus through 3.15.1 contains a credential leak vulnerability that allows attackers to capture Azure AD or Google IAM bearer tokens by redirecting remote_write requests to another host. Attackers controlling the remote-write endpoint or a redirecting server can return a 3xx to their host and replay the token, for example to write metrics to the victim's backend.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-119566

item.title: [Segurança] CVE-2026-119558 - Check Point
item.description:
🚨 CVE-2026-119558 - Check Point
 
Criticidade: Baixa
Ferramenta: Check Point
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 3.1
Resumo:
OpenCart through 4.1.0.4 contains a business logic vulnerability that allows logged-in customers to place unpaid full-price orders by clearing reward points after selecting Free Checkout. Attackers can apply points, save Free Checkout, then submit zero points via reward.save so the confirm handler advances the order to Free Checkout status without payment.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-119558
